sourceTitle: Introducing the Microsoft Copilot harness: Unlocking the potential of truly multi-model agentic work
originalTitle: Introducing the Microsoft Copilot harness: Unlocking the potential of truly multi-model agentic work
author: Tina Schuchman CVP, Foundry, Vladimir Fedorov, CTO, GitHub

blocks.text: If you want to compete, you need to be multi-model. And if you want to take advantage of everything that different AI models have to offer, you need a great harness. But building one that works seamlessly across multiple models and surfaces is incredibly hard. You need to solve for performance, quality, and cost. And then you have to maintain it, which is even harder.
blocks.zh: 如果你想参加比赛,你需要多样模式。如果你想利用不同AI模型提供的一切你需要一个伟大的绳子。但是,建造一个在多个模型和表面无缝运行的模型是极其困难的。你需要解决表现,质量,和成本。然后你必须保持它,这更难。
blocks.en: If you want to compete, you need to be multi-model. And if you want to take advantage of everything that different AI models have to offer, you need a great harness. But building one that works seamlessly across multiple models and surfaces is incredibly hard. You need to solve for performance, quality, and cost. And then you have to maintain it, which is even harder.

blocks.text: Luckily, the GitHub engineering team built a best-in-class, truly multi-model harness, which we’ve adopted company-wide. The Microsoft Copilot harness powers Copilot Code, Copilot Studio, the GitHub Copilot app, the CLI, VS Code, and more. And today, we’re making that harness available through Microsoft Foundry. That gives developers and enterprise customers a fully managed way to build agents that reason, use tools, and complete complex, long-running tasks. You get the right model for the job without switching the harness or the rest of your tech stack. That frees up your time, energy, and resources to focus on your bottom line.
blocks.zh: 幸运的是,GitHub工程队建造了最优秀的真正的多模式的绳索,我们已采用全公司。微软Copilot驾驭权力 Copilot代码,Copilot工作室,GitHub Copilot应用程序,国家行动倡议,VS码,还有更多还有今天透过微软创始公司,这让开发商和企业客户有一个完全管理的方法 来建立代理商,使用工具,和完全的复杂,长期任务。你得到合适的模型 工作,没有切换带 或你的其余技术堆。这样你就可以腾出时间了能源,并有资源关注您的底线。
blocks.en: Luckily, the GitHub engineering team built a best-in-class, truly multi-model harness, which we’ve adopted company-wide. The Microsoft Copilot harness powers Copilot Code, Copilot Studio, the GitHub Copilot app, the CLI, VS Code, and more. And today, we’re making that harness available through Microsoft Foundry. That gives developers and enterprise customers a fully managed way to build agents that reason, use tools, and complete complex, long-running tasks. You get the right model for the job without switching the harness or the rest of your tech stack. That frees up your time, energy, and resources to focus on your bottom line.

blocks.text: What’s a harness, and why is it hard?
blocks.zh: 何谓绳索,为什么会很难呢?
blocks.en: What’s a harness, and why is it hard?

blocks.text: If the model supplies the intelligence, the harness is everything around the model. It’s the orchestration layer that gives an agent the right instructions, context, execution environment, and controls to accomplish meaningful work. And a harness worth its salt has support for open standards like MCP and agent skills, as well as agent plugins.
blocks.zh: 如果模型提供了情报,绳子就是模型周围的一切给代理商正确的指示,上下文,执行环境,并控制完成有意义的工作。值得一提的绳子 支持开放标准 比如MCP和代理技能还有代理插件。
blocks.en: If the model supplies the intelligence, the harness is everything around the model. It’s the orchestration layer that gives an agent the right instructions, context, execution environment, and controls to accomplish meaningful work. And a harness worth its salt has support for open standards like MCP and agent skills, as well as agent plugins.

blocks.text: This is a fast-moving space. A frontier model today might fall behind tomorrow. And building your own harness or model router to keep up can be painful and slow. Now, you can build on the same harness Microsoft and GitHub ship in our own products, and you don’t have to maintain it.
blocks.zh: 这是一个快速移动的空间。今天的边疆模式可能落后于明天。而建立你自己的吊带或模型路由器来跟上,可能很痛苦和缓慢.现在,你可以在微软和GitHub 飞船的相同控制下 在我们自己的产品上发展,也不必维持。
blocks.en: This is a fast-moving space. A frontier model today might fall behind tomorrow. And building your own harness or model router to keep up can be painful and slow. Now, you can build on the same harness Microsoft and GitHub ship in our own products, and you don’t have to maintain it.

blocks.text: We invest in science and engineering work to continually improve and evolve the harness and ensure high-quality, efficient, and low-cost performance across a range of models and workloads. The benefits compound for us and our customers who use the harness to build and run their own agents. Improve the harness, and every surface it touches benefits.
blocks.zh: 我们投资于科学和工程工作,以不断改进和发展利用并确保高质量,高效,以及一系列模式和工作量的低成本业绩。对我们和我们的客户来说 好处就是利用这种手段 建立和经营自己的代理人改善绳索,每一个表面都有好处。
blocks.en: We invest in science and engineering work to continually improve and evolve the harness and ensure high-quality, efficient, and low-cost performance across a range of models and workloads. The benefits compound for us and our customers who use the harness to build and run their own agents. Improve the harness, and every surface it touches benefits.

blocks.text: Born in GitHub, battle-tested at enterprise scale
blocks.zh: 出生于基特胡布,企业规模的战斗试验
blocks.en: Born in GitHub, battle-tested at enterprise scale

blocks.text: The Copilot harness was built by the same GitHub engineers behind new technologies like our multi-model orchestration. And those technologies are only possible because we built our own harness. Designed to be fast, token-efficient, and predictable, it was our original, high-quality harness. And it had the highest satisfaction among our most demanding audience: developers. That’s why we’re standardizing all of our Copilot experiences on the strongest foundation possible.
blocks.zh: Copilot带是由同样的 GitHub 工程师建造的 背后的新技术,比如我们的多型号的管弦乐。这些技术之所以可能 是因为我们建立了自己的技术。设计得很快,有节制的标志,和可预测的,这是我们的原作,高品质的吊带。我们最有要求的观众对此感到最满意:开发者。因此,我们正在将所有Copilot经验标准化,以尽可能牢固的基础。
blocks.en: The Copilot harness was built by the same GitHub engineers behind new technologies like our multi-model orchestration. And those technologies are only possible because we built our own harness. Designed to be fast, token-efficient, and predictable, it was our original, high-quality harness. And it had the highest satisfaction among our most demanding audience: developers. That’s why we’re standardizing all of our Copilot experiences on the strongest foundation possible.

blocks.text: The harness is built to perform across model families, with 20+ frontier models plus bring your own key, so you can use the right model for the right job. Instead of doing the work to keep up with and eval new models, lean on us to intelligently route work to the right model or models based on the task.
blocks.zh: 吊带是用来跨模范家庭表演的,20+边疆模型 加上你自己的钥匙,这样你就可以用合适的模型来做合适的工作了.与其努力跟上新模式 不如重新审视新模式倚靠我们 明智的路线工作 正确的模型或模型 基于任务。
blocks.en: The harness is built to perform across model families, with 20+ frontier models plus bring your own key, so you can use the right model for the right job. Instead of doing the work to keep up with and eval new models, lean on us to intelligently route work to the right model or models based on the task.

blocks.text: Our harness is flexible and configurable to any type of app, agent, or service. We recently ported the harness runtime to Rust, which has resulted in industry-leading performance and reductions in both session overhead and time-to-first token. And because the Copilot harness powers surfaces across Microsoft, it’s battle-tested and proven performant at the scale of millions of users and hundreds of real-world use cases.
blocks.zh: 我们的绳索很灵活,可以适应任何类型的应用,探员,或服务。我们最近把绳索移到拉斯特这导致行业领先的绩效和会议管理费和时间与头等大事的减少。并且因为Copilot驾驭着微软的能量,以数百万用户和数以百计真实世界使用案例的规模,
blocks.en: Our harness is flexible and configurable to any type of app, agent, or service. We recently ported the harness runtime to Rust, which has resulted in industry-leading performance and reductions in both session overhead and time-to-first token. And because the Copilot harness powers surfaces across Microsoft, it’s battle-tested and proven performant at the scale of millions of users and hundreds of real-world use cases.

blocks.text: A unified harness lets us ship faster, learn faster, and improve Copilot over time. And because the agents you build in Foundry can run on the same harness we’ve adopted across Microsoft, our continuous harness improvements will benefit your agents, too.
blocks.zh: 统一的绳子可以让我们更快的飞船学得更快并随着时间的推移改进Copilot。而且因为你在铸币局建造的智能体们 也能用我们用过的一样的绳子运行 在微软上,我们的不断改进 将有利于你的智能体,我也一样。
blocks.en: A unified harness lets us ship faster, learn faster, and improve Copilot over time. And because the agents you build in Foundry can run on the same harness we’ve adopted across Microsoft, our continuous harness improvements will benefit your agents, too.

blocks.text: The SDK is available to download, or you can run the harness in the cloud, all managed by Foundry. Our platforms remain open and interoperable, so you can continue to bring in any harness and framework you want, too.
blocks.zh: SDK可以下载,或者你可以在云中运行绳索,都由铸币局管理我们的平台保持开放和互操作性这样你就可以继续 带来任何你想要的绳索和框架,我也一样。
blocks.en: The SDK is available to download, or you can run the harness in the cloud, all managed by Foundry. Our platforms remain open and interoperable, so you can continue to bring in any harness and framework you want, too.

blocks.text: With the Copilot harness, Microsoft runs the agent loop and sandbox, with governance and optimization built in from day one. You bring the instructions, skills, tools, and model choice.
blocks.zh: 用Copilot带,微软运行代理环和沙盒,从第一天起就开始管理和优化。你带指示来技术,工具,和模型选择。
blocks.en: With the Copilot harness, Microsoft runs the agent loop and sandbox, with governance and optimization built in from day one. You bring the instructions, skills, tools, and model choice.

blocks.text: This is an important step towards our vision of a stronger system around the model that preserves choice. It represents the best of GitHub, brought to the Microsoft platform and beyond.
blocks.zh: 这是朝着我们关于围绕保留选择的模式建立一个更强有力的系统的愿景迈出的重要一步。它代表着GitHub最好的,被带入微软平台及之外.
blocks.en: This is an important step towards our vision of a stronger system around the model that preserves choice. It represents the best of GitHub, brought to the Microsoft platform and beyond.

blocks.text: We’ll keep pushing the harness forward, so you can focus on what only you can build.
blocks.zh: 我们将会继续推动绳索前进,所以,你可以专注于什么 只有你能建造。
blocks.en: We’ll keep pushing the harness forward, so you can focus on what only you can build.
